capabilities: Run SQL against CloudBeaver server connections from a docked results panel or tab
Execute queries written in cloudbeaver code blocks inside notes
Configure connections with aliases, default database overrides, and read-only or writable modes
Copy query results as Markdown tables
Browse and reuse the last 50 queries
disambiguation: Not a standalone database client; it only reaches databases through a self-hosted CloudBeaver server.
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.7.2+. Credentials are stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json inside the vault. Connections are read-only by default; writes must be enabled per connection. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run SQL against external databases or keep runnable queries alongside notes.

relations.evidence: This is an Obsidian community plugin for CloudBeaver - a web-based database management tool.

requires.name: CloudBeaver credentials (username/password or PRO API token)

summary: SQL client for CloudBeaver servers that runs queries from a sidebar results panel or from cloudbeaver code blocks in notes.
